svg.aria-label: Design decisions: NAT stays at the edge. The ISR 4331 owns the internet link and runs NAT, so OPNsense can filter and inspect traffic without adding a second layer of NAT. Routing happens at the core. The core 3850 routes between VLANs and relays DHCP to Active Directory, leaving the firewall to guard traffic in and out of the network. One 20G uplink. Two 10G links in an LACP port-channel join the core and access switches. That doubles the bandwidth, and the uplink stays up if one cable fails. Split hypervisor networking. Proxmox is managed on VLAN 10, while its VMs use a separate trunk for VLANs 20 and 40, so host management never shares a link with VM traffic. One AP, two networks. One access point broadcasts the Internal and Guest SSIDs. Each SSID maps to its own VLAN, and both ride a single trunked switch port. Automation. Ansible manages device configuration, so every change is repeatable, reviewable and tracked.
svg.title: Design decisions
